node_definition.done_when:
At the committed head, with plan section 10 as the authority: (1) The candidate filter in reckon/crew/picker/ removes a candidate only when it cannot run: its serving observation reads refused, unavailable or logged out; the node exceeds its context window; its provider window is at or above the hard utilisation ceiling; its gate is paused or unreadable; or dispatch would refuse it on competence. A test shows a metered candidate at burn 3.4 times pace and one at zero local worker slots both offered, with those figures in the rendered state. (2) No routing decision is made in code: the exact-to-local shortcut is removed, every pick with at least one offered candidate calls Jev, and a test asserts the client is called for an exact node. (3) The route Choice offers hold (do not dispatch now; wait for pressure to ease) beside the backends. A hold selection returns no backend, action hold and Jev's confidence, with a test. (4) The alignment lives only in reckon/crew/picker/templates/. It says pressure on a metered lane (burn ahead of pace, little remaining window, congestion) raises the bar for using it on a sliding scale: well-defined, low-risk work goes to the local lane, deferrable work may hold when every lane is pressed, and hard, high-risk or deep-reasoning work may still take a pressed metered lane. Confidence is read as Jev's, not compared against a fixed pick threshold for pressure. A test asserts no numeric burn or pace threshold appears in reckon/crew/picker/*.py or the templates. (5) Per candidate the state carries return_time for this node's size, burn_multiple, pace_allowance, utilisation_pct, days_to_reset, budget source, age and stale flag, congestion and recent outcomes. It also carries the node's difficulty signals: spec level, capability requirements, estimated hours and attempts. The live pick path passes project, ledger records and the budget snapshot, so a test with synthetic ledger rows shows a non-null return_time through reckon.crew.picker's public pick entry, not only through lane_context. (6) The rendered representative state stays at or under 1,500 tokens. (7) The gate is every tests/test_picker*.py file, tests/test_skill_contracts.py and tests/test_crew_help_names_its_state.py at base and head, with zero added failure ids.
 Shared contract with the concurrent node picker-in-dispatch: the public pick entry that reckon crew pick calls accepts a keyword cached_only (default False), which reads serving observations from the existing probe cache only and never starts a live probe. Its selection carries an action field whose value is one of route, hold, fallback or refuse, with backend null for hold and refuse.
